# idle-resource-finder

> Find idle cloud resources in a provider-neutral JSON inventory: unattached volumes, idle or long-stopped instances, free IPs, orphaned snapshots, with Decimal savings Python package `trysac-idle-resource-finder`, import name `idle_resource_finder`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
